heading: Terms of Use
intro: Information about using the Culbertson Agency website and online enquiry forms.
body:
About this website

This website is operated for Aaspire Agency DBA Culbertson Agency, serving insurance customers in Florida. These terms explain the use of our website, quote tools and enquiry forms. Read our Privacy Policy for information about personal data.

Insurance enquiries and coverage

Website descriptions and form responses provide general information and help us understand your request. They are not a policy, binder, guarantee of coverage or final premium. Eligibility, coverage, exclusions and pricing depend on the insurer and the applicable policy terms.

Sending a form, receiving a reference number or speaking with us about a quote does not itself start, change, renew or cancel coverage. Obtain confirmation from an authorized agency representative or insurer before relying on a coverage change.

Information you provide

Provide accurate information and update our team if your circumstances or instructions change. Use forms only for information relevant to the request. Do not send passwords, payment card details, Social Security numbers or sensitive medical information through general enquiry forms.

Quote forms save details when you select Continue. Our team can review a saved, unfinished request. Contact preferences shown in the form remain separate from these website terms.

Appropriate use

Use the website lawfully. Do not attempt to access another person's information, bypass security, upload malicious files, interfere with the website or submit deceptive requests. Website text, branding and media remain the property of their respective owners or licensors.

Availability and external links

We work to keep information useful and current, but website content may change and services may be interrupted. External insurer and service-provider websites operate under their own terms and privacy notices. Verify important insurance information directly with our agency.

Questions and updates

Contact Culbertson Agency at (239) 210-7700 or through our Contact page. Our office is at 13099 S Cleveland Ave, Suite 310, Fort Myers, FL 33907. Updates to these terms will be posted on this page.

heading: Privacy Choices
intro: A clear way to ask questions about your information and manage how our Florida agency contacts you.
body:
Tell us your preference

You can ask our agency about information we hold, request a correction or deletion, ask about sharing, or change your contact preferences. Use the form below, call (239) 210-7700, or write to Culbertson Agency, 13099 S Cleveland Ave, Suite 310, Fort Myers, FL 33907.

How requests are handled

Submitting this form records a request for our team to review. We may need to verify your identity, your authority to act for someone else, or the information involved before responding. Do not upload identification documents or sensitive personal information to this form.

Available options and our response may depend on applicable law and the circumstances. Some information may need to be retained for insurance administration, fraud prevention, security, legal obligations or record-retention requirements. A privacy request does not cancel or change insurance coverage.

Contact preferences

Tell us which telephone number or email address your request concerns and which communications you want to stop or change. We may still need to send communications required to administer a policy or respond to your request, where permitted or required. See SMS and Contact Terms for more information.

Sale and sharing

Our Privacy Policy states that the agency does not sell or rent personal information to third parties. You can still record a preference or ask a sharing question using the do-not-sell option below. See Do not sell my personal information.

heading: Do Not Sell My Personal Information
intro: Understand our agency's policy and record your privacy preferences.
body:
Our agency's policy

The Culbertson Agency Privacy Policy states that we do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. That policy also describes sharing with insurers, service providers and authorities for the purposes described there.

Record a preference or ask a question

If you would like to record a do-not-sell or sharing preference, or ask how information is handled, send a privacy request. You may also call (239) 210-7700 or write to Culbertson Agency, 13099 S Cleveland Ave, Suite 310, Fort Myers, FL 33907.

Requests go to our agency team for review. This link does not automatically change browser settings, remove stored records or cancel insurance. We may need to verify the request and explain any applicable insurance or legal record-retention requirements.

Browser choices

For browser storage and cookies, see Cookies and Other Technology. For contact preferences, use Privacy Choices.

heading: Cookies and Other Technology
intro: How browser storage supports website security and the quote experience.
body:
Cookies and browser storage

Cookies are small pieces of data stored by your browser. This application uses first-party session cookies to support secure requests, form validation and signed-in sessions. Quote tools also use browser storage for flow identifiers that help keep a saved request together. These identifiers are not a substitute for your insurance policy or confirmation of coverage.

Saved quote progress

The information submitted when you select Continue in a quote form is saved on our server. Removing browser cookies or stored identifiers does not delete that server record. To ask about a saved request or request deletion, use Privacy Choices.

Your browser controls

Your browser settings allow you to inspect, block or delete cookies and site storage. Blocking necessary storage may prevent forms, request resumption or administrator sign-in from working correctly. This page explains storage; it is not a switch that enables or disables advertising or analytics technology.

External services and changes

When you follow a link to an insurer or another website, that service may use its own cookies and privacy controls. Check its notice separately. If additional analytics or advertising tools are introduced, their purposes and any relevant choices should be described in an updated notice.

Questions

Contact our Fort Myers team at (239) 210-7700, or send a privacy question. Read the Privacy Policy for the agency's broader information practices.

heading: SMS and Contact Terms
intro: How we use the contact choices you provide with an enquiry or quote request.
body:
Responding to your request

When you supply contact details with an enquiry, Culbertson Agency uses those details to respond to the request and the preferences you provide. Quote forms separately ask for permission to contact you about a saved request, including if you do not finish it.

Text messages are optional

The quote form's text-message option is separate and is not preselected. Selecting it records your request for text messages about that enquiry. Leaving it unselected does not prevent you from completing the quote form. Message frequency can vary and your carrier's message or data charges may apply if messages are sent.

The website records your preference; saving the form does not itself send an SMS. This notice does not create a subscription, authorize unrelated marketing, or replace any additional consent that may be required for a particular messaging service.

Changing a preference or getting help

Call (239) 210-7700 or use Privacy Choices to tell our agency which number or email address you want us to stop using or update. If you receive a message, you may also follow the opt-out instructions supplied with it. The website does not provide an automated STOP/HELP text service.

Insurance and privacy

A communication preference does not change or cancel insurance coverage. Some policy-administration or legally required communications may still be necessary. For handling of personal information, see the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
